description:
Media player for your own M3U playlists and Xtream Codes logins. Ships no channels or content.

Nightmare TV is a media player. It does not provide, host, sell, link to or
recommend any channels, streams, playlists or subscriptions. You bring your
own legally obtained M3U playlist or Xtream Codes login; the app is the
playback engine and nothing else.

It runs on a native libmpv engine rather than a generic framework player:

- Real BT.2390 HDR tone-mapping with per-frame peak detection
- Dolby Atmos, DTS-X and TrueHD passthrough over HDMI on capable devices
- 4K HEVC Main10, AV1 and VP9 hardware decode
- Recording and scheduled DVR on a single provider connection
- Multi-day XMLTV guide, catch-up, live rewind and multiview
- Automatic picture tier: measures what the device can sustain and steps
  down by itself if it detects real stutter

Also available for macOS, Android, Android TV and Fire TV. A 7-day trial
needs no card and no account and starts at your first playback.
